improvements: Moved the facade approximately 330 m east from an underground tunnel-lid polygon end to the actual mapped tunnel highway mouths.
Aligned all three openings and solid collision piers around independent highway endpoints; the modern bore uses the documented 19.2 m diameter.
The facade claims no building replacements, preserving the historic tunnel lid and nearby houses.
remainingGaps: Facade wall height, narrow bore sizes, retaining-wall depths, artwork relief and the short wooded embankment are explicit visual estimates.
Only the east facade is modelled, with no surveyed tunnel interior or per-bore vertical road-level fit.
The carved inscription uses a coarse block font; this capture does not establish street-eye fidelity.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.
Integrated source-only replacement and rebuilt district performance are separate acceptance checks; the capture branch predates that shared world policy.
